name: Benhanan
overview: Benhanan is a male member of the tribe of Judah, identified specifically as the son of Shimon. His mention in Scripture is brief, with no additional notes or extended narrative about his life or deeds. His identity is primarily anchored in his paternal lineage as recorded in 1 Chronicles 4:20.
namesAndTitles: The name Benhanan means 'son of grace,' reflecting a Hebrew origin and revealing a meaningful designation rather than a title. This proper name was not given directly by God but holds significance in its meaning within the biblical context.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records that Benhanan is the son of Shimon, establishing a clear paternal relationship. Beyond this, no other family relationships are documented in the biblical text for Benhanan.
scriptureSignificance: Benhanan's significance lies in his genealogical placement within the tribe of Judah, as the son of Shimon. His mention in 1 Chronicles 4:20 contributes to the biblical record of the descendants of Judah, underscoring the importance of lineage and heritage in God's providential plan. While the text does not elaborate on his personal achievements, his inclusion preserves the continuity of God's chosen people.
